Overview of Jeju Province Region (제주특별자치도)

Jeju Province Region (제주특별자치도) is located in the Jeju Province region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Jeju-si. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Seongsan Ilchulbong Sunrise Peak, Hallasan National Park, Jeju Olle Walking Trails, Udo Island & Manjanggul Lava Tube.

RegionJeju Province
Capital cityJeju-si
Cities & municipalities12
Primary transport hubJeju-si Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Jeju Province Region

1-hour flight from Seoul Gimpo (GMP) or Busan to Jeju International Airport (CJU); island express buses and rental cars. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Jeju Province

When visiting cities across Jeju Province, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Jeju Black Pork BBQ (Heukdwaeji)
  • Abalone porridge (Jeonbokjuk)
  • Hairtail fish (Galchi jorim)
  • Hallabong citrus sweets
  • Gogi guksu (pork noodle soup)

Best time to visit Jeju Province

Best time to visit Jeju Province: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
